description_en: Lists the resource directories of a collaborative share
description_zh: 列举协作空间资料目录
name: ListGroupDirectories

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaborative share
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a visible directory in the current space. If this parameter is omitted or set to root, the space root is queried. The first query reuses the existing service-initialized internal root directory
parameters.help_zh: 当前空间可见目录 ID；省略或 root 查询空间根，首次沿用现有服务初始化内部根目录
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Valid values: name, gmt_create, and gmt_modified
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: asc and desc
parameters.name: sort_order

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

directories.description_en: The query root itself and all its descendant directories, including visible referenced directories in the space. The results are not paginated
directories.description_zh: 查询根自身及全部后代目录，包含空间可见引用目录，不分页

directoryId.description_en: The directory ID, including the query root itself and its descendants
directoryId.description_zh: 目录 ID，包含查询根自身及其后代

directoryType.description_en: The original directory type. The value is GROUP for physical directories in the space. Referenced directories retain their original type
directoryType.description_zh: 原始目录类型；空间物理目录为 GROUP，引用目录保留原类型

parentDirectoryId.description_en: The parent directory ID. This value is empty for the internal root of the space
parentDirectoryId.description_zh: 父目录 ID；空间内部根为空

readOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the directory is a read-only referenced directory. A value of false still requires creator or administrator permissions to modify the directory. The internal root is always unmodifiable
readOnly.description_zh: 是否为只读引用目录；false 仍需创建者或管理员权限才能修改，内部根始终不可修改

totalCount.description_en: The number of returned directories, which equals the length of the directories array
totalCount.description_zh: 返回目录数量，等于 directories 长度
